sentences.text: Social worker Fiona Grant (S1) identified herself as the social worker and noted she had previously visited in the summer.
Edna Holloway (S2) recalled the previous visit, noting the social worker wore a green coat.
Edna Holloway (S2) agreed to the social worker sitting down and requested Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) to stay with them.
Edna Holloway (S2) stated that Joy Mensah (S3) does her hair.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) clarified that Joy only does Edna's hair on Thursdays.
Edna Holloway (S2) described the food as 'alright' but 'bit bland' and expressed liking the lounge and the view of the garden.
Edna Holloway (S2) stated she gets about using a frame and that Joy or one of the girls walks her to the dining room.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) reported that Edna has been 'really steady' since the physio in September.
Edna Holloway (S2) reported that her left hearing aid whistles.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) stated that an audiology appointment is booked for the 8th of December.
Edna Holloway (S2) reported that her daughter, Pauline, still phones every Sunday from Inverness, but Pauline 'can't get down much'.
Edna Holloway (S2) expressed a wish to 'feel safe in her room' and 'want him kept away from her end'.
Edna Holloway (S2) expressed a wish for a room nearer the lounge, stating 'I've asked before'.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) reported that Room 4 is coming free next week.
Edna Holloway (S2) disclosed that on the night of Saturday the 14th of November, she woke up and there was a man (identified as Mr Pike/Arthur Pike) in her bed, under the covers, '
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) reported that Mr Pike was in Edna's bed, under the covers, next to her, and that Edna was awake, upset, and told him to 'get off'.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) reported that she got Mr Pike up, walked him back to his room, sat with Edna, and wrote the incident in the incident book.
Edna Holloway (S2) disclosed that the man touched her on her bottom and her front 'under her nightie'.
Edna Holloway (S2) stated she told the man to stop, saying 'stop it, get out' 'a lot of times'.
Edna Holloway (S2) reported that the man did not stop immediately ('
Edna Holloway (S2) disclosed that since the incident, she does not sleep well and keeps the light on.
Edna Holloway (S2) denied that Mr Pike had come into her room before the incident on the night of the 14th of November, stating 'No. Never before. That was the first time'.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) reported that there is nothing in the records about Mr Pike going into Edna's room before the incident.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) reported that she told Mrs Dobson (the manager) on the Monday morning about the incident.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) reported that Mrs Dobson stated Mr Pike was confused, went into the wrong room, and that it 'didn't need reporting' and she should not 'make a f
Edna Holloway (S2) stated that her daughter Pauline 'sorts that out' regarding money and that she 'sold the bungalow'.
Edna Holloway (S2) agreed that the social worker should tell her daughter Pauline about the incident.
Social worker Fiona Grant (S1) stated she would raise a safeguarding concern with the council and ask the police to be informed.
Social worker Fiona Grant (S1) stated she would speak to Mrs Dobson this afternoon about why the incident was not reported and to ensure the Care Quality Commission are notified.
Social worker Fiona Grant (S1) stated she would ask that Mr Pike has extra checks at night from tonight and a sensor on his door.
